name: @b2y/ai-service
description: Reusable, task-oriented AI orchestration for B2Y applications: trusted context, schema-validated structured output, self-hosted OpenAI-compatible providers.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist','build']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && cd build && node --test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.demo:groq: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node build/examples/LeadSummaryDemo.js
scripts.demo:groq:env: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --env-file=.env build/examples/LeadSummaryDemo.js
